equity.level_reason: Racial composition of recipients is reported by period and framed as improving equity, but values are only set side by side (46% vs 53% Black) with no computed difference or ratio, so the level is capped at 2.

level_alternative.reason: The pilot is explicitly an equity intervention; the Black share shift could be read as a quantified disparity contrast, and supply, demand, hesitancy and stigma are named as causes.

equity.equity_measurement: Equity is judged by the share of Black recipients before vs during the festival; no comparison with case shares (77% Black, cited) or population denominators. Race 'Other' collapses NHPI, AI/AN, multiracial and declined.

notes: Design inferred: the report calls itself a vaccine pilot; mapped to evaluation, with before/after for the two periods. Case figures (1,784 cases, 77% Black) and pre-festival vaccination shares are cited from other sources, not computed here.
view_issues: The success claim rests on a 46% vs 53% Black share shift with no test or benchmark; 31% of records lack state of residence.
